blocks.html: The attributes in the tax rate to be created or updated.

types.name: id
types.description:
The ID of the tax rate. If not provided, the tax rate
is created.

types.name: code
types.description: The code of the tax rate.

types.name: name
types.description: The name of the tax rate.

types.name: is_default
types.description: Whether the tax rate is default.

types.name: created_by
types.description:
Who created the tax rate. For example, the
ID of the user that created it.

types.name: metadata
types.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.
